title: Knowledge as Code
abstract: arXiv:2610.27693v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: For millennia, knowledge has been carried by language, and large language models still put language at the center. Yet the coding agents built on these models mostly write code. This paper is a contribution to epistemology, which asks what kind of knowledge code is and how it is obtained. We define knowledge as code as knowledge written in a programming language or in a machine-parsable data format, whose validity can be checked by executing it. We define thirteen epistemic properties of knowledge media and show that code is the first medium to have all of them. We distinguish two ways in which knowledge enters code, encoding and learning by execution, where code is both the experiment and the record of its result. Agents make learning by execution observable, since their trajectories record every probe, observation and line of code they keep. translated_abstract: 千百年来，知识一直由语言承载，大型语言模型也依然将语言置于核心地位。然而，构建在这些模型之上的编程智能体却大多在编写代码。本文是对认识论的一项贡献，探讨代码是何种知识以及它是如何获得的。我们将“知识即代码”定义为：以编程语言或机器可解析数据格式书写的知识，其有效性可以通过执行来检验。我们定义了知识载体的十三种认识论属性，并证明代码是第一种同时具备所有这些属性的载体。我们区分了知识进入代码的两种方式：编码和通过执行学习，在后者中代码既是实验本身，也是实验结果的记录。智能体使“通过执行学习”变得可观察，因为它们的轨迹记录了每一次探测、观察以及保留的每一行代码。因此，代码不仅是知识工作的工具，其本身也是一种独立的知识载体。
tldr: 该论文从认识论角度提出“知识即代码”框架，定义了十三种知识载体属性并证明代码是首个同时具备全部属性的载体，同时区分了编码与通过执行学习两种知识获取方式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an epistemological framework of "knowledge as code," defines thirteen epistemic properties of knowledge media and shows that code is the first medium possessing all of them, while distinguishing encoding and learning by execution as the two ways knowledge enters code.
